content.value_statement: Producing video across AI models, avatars, and code tools can be hard to plan. This skill guides tool choice, prompts, workflows, and production steps.
actual_capabilities: Selects programmatic, AI generation, avatar, or repurposing workflows.
Compares Hyperframes and Remotion for templated video builds.
Provides structured prompts for AI video generation models.
Guides product demo, explainer, and social clip production.
Recommends avatar tools and recurring video pipelines.
Lists aspect ratio and caption considerations for distribution.
limitations: Does not render or edit video files by itself.
Tool pricing and model availability can change and should be verified.
Generated model recommendations may need current provider checks.
Requires user assets, product context, or API access for production.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Demo
use_cases.description: Create a practical workflow for scripting, recording, overlays, captions, and export settings.

use_cases.title: Create Recurring Avatar Updates
use_cases.description: Design a repeatable AI avatar process for weekly product news without filming a presenter.

use_cases.title: Build Programmatic Video Templates
use_cases.description: Choose Hyperframes or Remotion for reusable video templates and batch production.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Video Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a video for [platform] about [product or offer]. Recommend the best production approach, tools, length, aspect ratio, and first steps.

prompt_templates.title: Write an AI Video Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a video generation prompt for [scene]. Include subject, action, camera movement, visual style, lighting, mood, and technical specs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Avatar Video Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable AI avatar workflow for [audience]. Include script structure, personalization fields, review steps, captions, and publishing formats.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Batch Video Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a batch video pipeline for [number] variations using [data source]. Compare Hyperframes and Remotion, then define assets, template logic, rendering, and QA.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team needs a two-minute homepage demo.
output: Recommended workflow: script the core value, record the real product flow, add programmatic overlays, include captions, and export in 16:9.
Use AI footage only for supporting visuals. Use real screen recordings for product UI because models can distort interfaces.

output_examples.input: A team wants weekly updates without appearing on camera.
output: Recommended workflow: use an AI avatar for narration, prepare a reusable script pattern, add product screenshots, and publish short captioned updates.
Test several avatar styles before committing to a recurring format.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants short clips from a webinar.
output: Recommended workflow: clean the source recording, extract the strongest moments, add captions and platform styling, then export vertical clips.
Prioritize clear hooks in the first seconds and adapt aspect ratios for each channel.

best_practices: Start with the video goal, audience, platform, and required length before choosing tools.
Use real product assets for interface scenes and AI generation for supporting visuals.
Add captions and verify aspect ratio before export.
anti_patterns: Starting with a tool choice before defining the message and platform.
Asking AI video models to create precise readable text or product UI.
Generating large batches before reviewing a small sample for quality.

faq.question: Can this skill create the final video file?
faq.answer: No. It guides planning, prompts, tool choice, and workflows. Rendering requires separate tools or services.

faq.question: Which tools does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Hyperframes, Remotion, HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Veo, Sora, Kling, Pika, Descript, Opus Clip, and CapCut.

faq.question: Is it useful for social video clips?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a workflow for turning long-form recordings into short clips with captions and platform formats.

faq.question: Does it support programmatic video?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares Hyperframes and Remotion for reusable templates, overlays, and batch rendering.

faq.question: Does it require API keys?
faq.answer: The skill itself does not require keys. Some recommended services may require accounts, credits, or API access.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
